text:
You need a WordPress 6.1 template and CSS build created from existing design artifacts and mock-ups, with some JavaScript as needed, and I can help deliver that under your guidance.  

I’m Tobias Reyne, with 7 years of experience in full stack work using JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. In a home goods storefront rebuild for Juniper & Ash Home, I replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS, improving largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s. In a multilingual documentation site for Gridbeam Robotics, I built a 4-language docs experience with instant search, and support tickets went down 27%.  

I’m comfortable working as part of a web build team and can jump in quickly. What parts of the WordPress build do you want me to focus on first: the CSS template, theme structure, or JavaScript interactions?
